title: Joe Rogan Experience #563 - David Choe
summary: A 2014 conversation about creative independence, public speech, work, health, money, sex, race and the consequences of turning private provocation into a broadcast. David Choe begins with Hong Dynasty and the prior proposed MMA fight, then recounts making Steve Lee wrestle for continued employment, filming paid-sex travel in Macau, diabetes and heavy-metal fears, disordered eating, Critter's training and injury, Regenokine and Asian-American male representation. Choe and Joe Rogan compare adolescent drawing, watercolor, publishing, television crews and independent media before tracing Choe's commercial-art experience on Vertical Limit and 28 Days. The second half covers Thumbs Up in Detroit, gambling treatment, private sexual and financial negotiations and an extended response to the DVDASA sexual-violence controversy. Choe denies the underlying event happened as narrated, says he exaggerated, accepts responsibility for publishing a story that sounded horrible, apologizes in part and also minimizes; Rogan states he cannot know the underlying fact and explains why listeners understood the account as assault. A separate Las Vegas story contains Steve Lee's direct refusal before Choe reports touching him; it is not absorbed into the earlier controversy. The episode closes with DVDASA production, doxxing, an unmade deceptive Girlfriend Experience proposal, the 2012 Reddit AMA, creative misery, sex-work/labor claims, han and ethnic essentialism, stand-up experiments and Bobby Lee recollections. Every explicit, offensive, contradictory and self-critical idea remains. Corrections, factual context, privacy, consent, medical caution and publication restrictions are separate metadata. No named line-level turns are published.

source_notes.claim: The captions label Joe Rogan, David Choe or Brian Redban per line.
source_notes.assessment: They do not. Episode context names participants, but line labels require held-out acoustic/video validation.

source_notes.claim: Diet and exercise simply return diabetes to non-diabetes.
source_notes.assessment: Type, diagnostic thresholds and remission criteria matter; preserve Choe's self-report without promising a cure.

source_notes.claim: Chewing and spitting is a workable shortcut.
source_notes.assessment: It is disordered-eating behavior and should not be presented as weight-management guidance.
This is Rogan's account of another person's outcome, not general clinical evidence.

source_notes.claim: Romeo Must Die scripted a kiss that was changed to dancing.
source_notes.assessment: Verify through production interviews or screenplay evidence before presenting the claim as settled film history.

source_notes.claim: The avalanche movie was probably titled Avalanche.
source_notes.assessment: The conversation itself resolves it to Vertical Limit; 28 Days is the following Sandra Bullock project.

source_notes.claim: Methamphetamine explains Hitler's judgment and genocide.
source_notes.assessment: Medication history may be documented, but the causal explanation is reductive and unsupported.

source_notes.claim: Three Thumbs Up seasons were out and Season 4 remained editing in 2014.
source_notes.assessment: This is valuable time-specific production evidence; surviving official and fan editions still require grouping.

source_notes.claim: This episode proves the original event occurred or did not occur.
source_notes.assessment: It proves Choe's later contradictory public response. The original recording, later statements and reporting must remain distinct.

source_notes.claim: Ongoing intercourse or paid workers imply consent to the new act.
source_notes.assessment: The direct refusal is act-specific and precedes the reported touching; context cannot reverse it.

source_notes.claim: Broadcasting from a psychiatric facility licenses participant identification.
source_notes.assessment: Setting and visible presence do not establish patient status or publication consent.

source_notes.claim: The November 2, 2012 AMA lasted 24 hours and used 200 participants.
source_notes.assessment: Treat scale as Choe's retrospective claim until contemporaneous Reddit/video archives are reconciled.
This is Choe's personal thesis, explicitly disputed by Rogan; never publish it as mental-health or creative advice.
Memory gaps alone do not establish trauma history; do not infer or diagnose an event.

source_notes.claim: The discussion states current sex-work law.
source_notes.assessment: It is a policy opinion and personal account; laws vary by place and time.

source_notes.claim: Han is genetic and Korean children inherit anger.
source_notes.assessment: Han is a contested cultural/historical concept, not a demonstrated gene or diagnostic trait.

speaker_policy.status: all line-level turns unresolved; named turns withheld
speaker_policy.reason: Episode context identifies Joe Rogan, David Choe and Brian Redban, but 4,293 automatic-caption segments have no publisher name prefixes and include quotation, imitation, visual media, laughter and overlapping dialogue. Topic ownership, name address and adjacency do not establish voice identity. Only independently listening/video-verified, non-overlapping held-out windows may support an experiment.
